title: 第1章 穿越直接喜提娘子第2章 洛雪儿
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: “一拜天地！”
“二拜高堂！”
“夫妻对拜！”
“夫妻对拜！”
此时，在一座庄严的大殿上，一对新人正在举行成亲仪式。此前一切流程都顺顺利利的，但是，到了夫妻对拜的环节，新郎的身体忽然晃动了一下，仿佛要倒下。
晃动几下之后，他最终还是没有倒下。但他站稳之后，却呆立不动，表情快速变换着，让旁人看得好生困惑。
坐在这对新人对面的，正是新郎官的父母。看到儿子一直痴痴傻傻站着，黎秋兰不禁有点着急。
“凡儿，快拜啊。”
新郎抬头看向黎秋兰，一位有着成熟风韵，又有一丝英气的美丽女人。
他这一瞥，黎秋兰感觉有点奇怪，新郎儿子脸色依然苍白得让人揪心，但此刻他的眼神却让人感觉有点陌生。
殊不知，此时新郎心里也在翻江倒海。
他叫莫凡，不久之前，地球上的他，在万念俱灰之中，从一处山崖纵身一跃，跳入深不见底被茫茫白雾缭绕的山崖。
自己不是应该死了吗，现在怎么会出现在结婚现场，而且自己还变成新郎了？
突然，一股庞大的记忆冲进他的脑海里。略微消化了这股记忆，莫凡终于把眼前的状况给弄清楚了。
他穿越了！
现在这具身体的原主人，也叫莫凡，是一个名叫玄武大陆的世界里，南域苍州一个修真门派云霄阁的少阁主。他面前坐着的，是这个莫凡少阁主的父亲莫唯风，以及母亲黎秋兰。
而今天跟少阁主莫凡大婚的，是云霄阁的大师姐，洛雪儿！
洛雪儿是莫唯风的养女，比莫凡大两岁，跟莫凡一块长大，从小就对莫凡照顾有加。
刚才少阁主身体的晃动，正是他魂魄归西的时候。而莫凡的魂魄恰好出现，接管了这具身体。
理清这些最基本的信息，莫凡看着坐在面前椅子上的新郎父母。或许是因为继承了这具身体，莫凡对这对中年夫妇心生莫名的亲切感。
既然用了你这身体，我就替你做完你该做的事情吧。
突然，一个声音在莫凡的脑海里响起：“小家伙，在这另一个世界里，开启你波澜壮阔的新人生吧！要记住，有很多人很多人在等着你。赶快成长起来吧。”
莫凡大吃一惊，谁在对他说话？而且是直接在他的脑海里说话，这是什么说话的方式？
他狐疑地看着四周，那些人还是一样的表情，并不是他们说的。
莫凡表情变换，心中思绪翻滚无数次，不过在外人看来也只过去了三四息时间。
“夫妻对拜！”
婚礼司仪的喊声再次传来。
莫凡暂时强压心中的困惑，整了整衣袖，将身子转向新娘，拜了下去。
黎秋兰脸上的焦急之色散去，脸上洋溢着幸福和满足。不过，细看之下，还有一缕忧愁。
莫唯风虽然表情严肃，但眼里也同样有着忧色。

"Worship heaven and earth!"
"Two thanks to Gaotang!"
"Couple greetings!"
...
"Couple greetings!"
...
At this time, in a solemn hall, a couple was holding a wedding ceremony. Before that, everything went smoothly, but when it came time for the couple to pay homage, the groom's body suddenly shook, as if he was about to fall down.
After shaking a few times, he finally did not fall down. But after he stood firm, he stood still and his expression changed rapidly, making others confused.
Sitting opposite the newlyweds were the groom's parents. Seeing her son standing stupidly all the time, Li Qiulan couldn't help but feel a little anxious.
"Fan'er, please worship me quickly."
The groom looked up at Li Qiulan, a beautiful woman with mature charm and a hint of heroism.
Li Qiulan felt a little strange when he glanced at him. The groom's son's face was still heart-wrenchingly pale, but the look in his eyes at this moment made people feel a little strange.
As everyone knows, the groom is also in a state of confusion at this time.
His name is Mo Fan. Not long ago, on earth, he jumped from a cliff in despair and jumped into the bottomless cliff shrouded in white mist.
Shouldn't he be dead? Why would he appear at the wedding now and become the groom?
Suddenly, a huge memory rushed into his mind. After digesting this memory for a while, Mo Fan finally understood the situation in front of him.
He has traveled through time!
The current original owner of this body, also named Mo Fan, is the young master of Yunxiao Pavilion, a cultivation sect in Cangzhou, Southern Territory, in a world called Xuanwu Continent. Sitting in front of him were Mo Weifeng, the father of Young Pavilion Master Mo Fan, and his mother, Li Qiulan.
And today, it is the senior sister of Yunxiao Pavilion, Luo Xueer, who is getting married to Young Pavilion Master Mo Fan!
Luo Xueer is Mo Weifeng's adopted daughter. She is two years older than Mo Fan. She grew up with Mo Fan and has taken good care of Mo Fan since she was a child.
The shaking of the Young Pavilion Master's body just now was the moment when his soul passed away. And Mo Fan's soul happened to appear and took over the body.
After sorting out the most basic information, Mo Fan looked at the groom's parents sitting on the chairs in front of him. Perhaps because he inherited this body, Mo Fan felt an inexplicable affinity for the middle-aged couple.
Since I have used your body, I will do what you should do for you.
Suddenly, a voice sounded in Mo Fan's mind: "Little guy, start your magnificent new life in this other world! Remember, there are many people waiting for you. Grow up quickly."
Mo Fan was shocked, who was talking to him? And he was speaking directly into his mind. What kind of speaking method was this?
He looked around suspiciously. Those people still had the same expression, and it wasn't what they said.
Mo Fan's expression changed, and his thoughts tumbled countless times, but in the eyes of outsiders, only three or four breaths had passed.
"Couple greetings!"
The shout of the wedding officiant came again.
Mo Fan temporarily suppressed the confusion in his heart, straightened his sleeves, turned to the bride, and bowed down.
The anxious look on Li Qiulan's face disappeared, and her face was filled with happiness and satisfaction. However, upon closer inspection, there is still a hint of sadness.
Although Mo Weifeng had a serious expression, there was also worry in his eyes.
title_en: Chapter 1: Traveling through time to marry the lady directly Chapter 2: Luo Xueer
